title: Two Items | Knarfy's One Item addon
description: A simple addon to Knarfy's One Item mod
body: This is a simple addon to the mod **Knarfy's One Item** that just adds some Quality of Life features. ## Current features: **Green Door:** * Green Door is now available in the creative menu * Green Door now drops when broken * Green Door now breaks faster with an axe **0.185 of a Cow:** * Added a spawn egg for 0.185 of a Cow Note: **Knarfy's One Item** is unlisted so you'll have to manually install it.
